narr: Strong thunderstorms produced a funnel cloud and flash flooding.
ev: Significant flooding was observed along George Bishop Parkway. Water level up to axles of mid-sized cars.
Embankment erosion and slumping on Highway 501 just before ICW bridge.
Frontage Road next to Highway 17 was impassable approximately 3 ESE of Socastee.
Several vehicles trapped in flood waters in the Socastee and Forestbrook areas.
lsr: FLOODED ROADWAY NEAR GEORGE BISHOP PARKWAY. WATER LEVEL UP TO AXELS OF MID-SIZED CARS.
HORRY COUNTY FIRE RESCUE RESPONDING TO CALLS INVOLVING VEHICLES TRAPPED IN FLOODWATERS IN THE SOCASTEE AND FORESTBROOK AREAS.
EMBANKMENT EROSION AND SLUMPING ON HIGHWAY 501 JUST BEFORE ICW BRIDGE.
FRONTAGE RD NEXT TO HIGHWAY 17 IMPASSABLE DUE TO FLASH FLOODING. LARGE TRUCKS OBSERVED TURNING BACK DUE TO DEPTH OF FLOODWATERS.
